title: 第4章 奇异矿石第5章 突破
lines: 矿坑外的风雪声被隔绝，洞内只剩下凝滞的黑暗和刺骨寒意。
卡拉斯背靠岩壁，每一次呼吸都带着冰碴刮过喉咙的剧痛。
肋下的暗影伤口在暗爪传递的温热力量压制下，不再冰寒刺骨，却转为火辣辣的灼痛，像滚烫的沙砾在皮肉下摩擦。
暗爪蜷缩在他身侧，紧贴着他受伤的肋骨，像个活体暖炉。
它似乎也耗尽了力气，熔金的竖瞳在黑暗中半睁半闭，随着呼吸微微起伏。
不知过了多久，一阵剧烈的闷痛将卡拉斯惊醒。
他猛地咳出血沫，溅在冰冷的地面上。
这动静惊动了暗爪。
它瞬间抬头，竖瞳在黑暗中聚焦，喉中发出警告性的嘶鸣。
爪子无意识地收紧，爪尖刺破了卡拉斯的皮肤。
刺痛让卡拉斯倒吸凉气，却也驱散了昏沉。
“没事…”
他喘息着，染血的手轻轻按在暗爪紧绷的脊背上，“只是咳嗽。”
暗爪的嘶鸣声低了下去，但警惕未消。
它转向矿坑深处的黑暗，鼻孔翕张，焦躁地刨着地面碎石。
卡拉斯的心提了起来。
暗爪的异常反应绝非偶然。
这头幼龙的本能感知远超人类。
“里面有…什么？”
他压低声音问道。
暗爪没有回答，只是喉中持续发出低沉的咕噜声，竖瞳死死盯着黑暗深处，尾巴不安地扫动。
寒意顺着卡拉斯的脊椎爬升。
矮人遗迹中潜藏的陷阱、守护者，或是被黑暗扭曲的造物，任何一样都可能是催命符。
但留在洞口等于等死。
他必须往深处去，寻找一线生机。
积攒起最后的力量，忍受着肋下的灼痛和全身骨骼的呻吟，卡拉斯咬紧牙关，扶着岩壁艰难地撑起身体。
每一次发力都带来钻心的剧痛，冷汗瞬间浸透衣衫。
他喘息着挤出这个字。
暗爪明白了他的意图。
它立刻起身，紧贴卡拉斯腿侧，竖瞳警惕地扫视前方，摆出随时准备扑击的姿势。
卡拉斯拄着一根半朽的木棍，拖着沉重的脚步向矿坑深处挪动。
暗爪紧跟在他脚边，爪子在湿滑的地面上不时打滑，却努力保持着平衡。
深入数十步后，洞口的天光彻底消失。
浓稠的黑暗吞噬了一切。
空气变得凝滞阴冷，带着尘土和金属锈蚀的气味。
唯一的光源是暗爪那双在黑暗中燃烧的熔金竖瞳。
“滴答…滴答…”
content_en:
The sound of wind and snow outside the mine was cut off, leaving only stagnant darkness and biting cold inside the cave.
Karas leaned against the rock wall, and every breath he took brought the sharp pain of ice scraping his throat.
The shadow wound under the ribs was suppressed by the warm power transmitted by the dark claws. It was no longer cold and biting, but turned into a burning pain, like hot gravel rubbing under the skin.
Darkpaw curled up at his side, pressed against his injured ribs like a living heater.
It also seemed to have exhausted all its strength. Its molten gold vertical pupils were half-open and half-closed in the darkness, rising and falling slightly with its breathing.
I don't know how long it took, but a sharp pain woke Karas up.
He coughed up blood, which splashed on the cold ground.
This movement alarmed Darkpaw.
It raised its head instantly, its vertical pupils focused in the darkness, and it let out a warning hiss in its throat.
The claws tightened unconsciously, and the tips of the claws pierced Karas' skin.
The stinging pain made Karas gasp, but it also dispelled the drowsiness.
"It's okay..."
He gasped, his blood-stained hand gently pressing Darkclaw's tense back, "It's just a cough."
Darkclaw's whinnying subsided, but his vigilance remained.
It turned towards the darkness deep in the mine, its nostrils flaring, and it anxiously dug at the gravel on the ground.
Karas's heart lifted.
Darkclaw's unusual reaction was no accident.
The baby dragon's instinctive perception far exceeds that of humans.
"What's...in there?"
he asked in a low voice.
Darkpaw didn't answer, but continued to make a low gurgling sound in his throat, his vertical eyes staring intently into the darkness, and his tail flicking uneasily.
A chill ran up Karas's spine.
Hidden traps, guardians in the dwarf ruins, or creations twisted by darkness, any of them may be a talisman.
But staying at the entrance of the cave is equivalent to waiting for death.
He must go deep and look for a glimmer of hope.
Gathering up his last strength and enduring the burning pain in his ribs and the groaning of his bones, Karas gritted his teeth and held onto the rock wall to push himself up with difficulty.
Every time he exerted force, he felt excruciating pain, and his clothes instantly soaked in cold sweat.
"Let's go..."
He gasped out the word.
Darkpaw understood his intention.
It immediately stood up and clung to the side of Karas's leg. Its vertical pupils scanned the front vigilantly, and it assumed a posture ready to pounce at any time.
Carras was leaning on a half-rotted wooden stick and dragging heavy steps deeper into the mine.
Dark Claw followed closely at his feet, its claws slipping from time to time on the slippery ground, but trying hard to maintain balance.
After dozens of steps deep, the light at the entrance of the cave completely disappeared.
Thick darkness swallowed everything.
The air became stagnant and cold, carrying the smell of dust and corroded metal.
The only source of light was Darkclaw's molten gold vertical pupils burning in the darkness.
"Tick tock...tick tock..."
